fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) has a price target of $324.74, representing 24.8% upside from the current price of $260.21, with AWS Q3 revenue growth of 39% as a key catalyst.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS operating margin of 38.7% shows strong profitability, but free cash flow is negative due to $22 billion in capital expenditures.
fields.summary_ko.2: Management projects AWS growth of 40% or more for 2027 and 2028 respectively, and expects to reach $1 trillion in revenue within the next 5-10 years.
